title: An unknown booking is refused with an Error, not a RangeError (kept for values out of bounds); the methods' comments say so
covers: kind of error raised by a handle method and an operation changes
errors are part of what an entry hands back (second design, rule 1)
note: The Bookings handle and the BookingOps table are unchanged; the error kinds are written on the methods that raise them, where the tool does not read @throws.
